lines.text: The bedroom lights clicked off, and Leo pulled the cozy blankets up to his chin!
Creak! A giant spiky silhouette stretched across his bedroom closet door!
Is that a secret clawed monster lurking in the shadows? Leo's heart beat fast!
He reached out his trembling hand and clicked on his little superhero flashlight!
Click! Warm golden light filled the corner, showing his winter jacket and baseball cap!
The coat rack had cast a funny shadow because the nightlight was low on the floor!
Shadows look spooky because your imagination tries to fill in the dark spaces!
Whenever you feel scared of shadows, just shine your light and meet the silly truth!
Be brave at bedtime and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
